title: Terraform logging & retention enforcer: S3 lifecycle + CloudTrail delivery + OpenSearch ILM upgrade orchestrator
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a composable Terraform module that enforces logging delivery, S3 lifecycle retention, and OpenSearch/ELK index lifecycle migration for Private (VPC) deployments. The module must be idempotent, safe for in-place upgrades, and include runtime health checks and alerting hooks. It should support cross-account CloudTrail delivery, KMS-managed encryption, tiered retention (hot->warm->cold->archive), and snapshot lifecycle management for OpenSearch clusters. Also provide migration helpers to convert legacy ELK ILM policies into OpenSearch-compatible ILM and a set of automated preflight checks to run during upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes reusable resources: cloudtrail_delivery_bucket, s3_lifecycle_policy, kms_key, opensearch_ilm_policy, snapshot_repository
Module supports a dry-run / plan-only mode that emits a migration plan for index ILM changes
Upgrade path updated: can perform zero-downtime ILM policy transitions for indices with rollover thresholds
Health check Lambda + CloudWatch dashboard that validates CloudTrail delivery, S3 object lifecycle transitions, OpenSearch snapshot success, and recent index rollover events
Automated integration tests run in CICD: create CloudTrail -> deliver events -> verify index creation and ILM transitions -> snapshot -> restore
Documentation and runbook for on-call: upgrade checklist, rollback steps, expected metrics and alert thresholds
work_items: Design TF module interface and variables (kms options, retention tiers, cross-account config)
Implement S3 lifecycle policy generator with parameterized tier durations and Glacier/Glacier Deep Archive transitions
CloudTrail delivery: ensure bucket policy, cross-account principals, and S3 object lock compatibility checks
OpenSearch ILM templates: create migration shim for legacy ELK ILM -> OpenSearch ILM and test on staging
Snapshot lifecycle: configure repository (S3 + role), retention, and scheduled snapshot Lambda
Health checks: implement Lambda checks + CloudWatch metrics + Console dashboard panels
CICD tests: add terraform integration tests and a synthetic workload that exercises rollover and snapshotting
Docs: write module usage examples, upgrade runbook, and sample policies for high/low retention customers
